d.

Ditto

Founding Head of Growth & Regional Director, NorCal

Jun 2025 – Mar 2026

150K+organic users
4M+campaign impressions

I ran Ditto's Berkeley account, with videos created by me and my team. I combined campus content, growth experiments, and on-the-ground campaigns to turn attention into adoption.

  • Scaled outreach and onboarding to 150,000+ organic users across 15+ U.S. colleges within two semesters.
  • Recruited and managed campus marketing teams at Berkeley, UC Davis, UCSB, and UCR.
  • Executed campaigns, events, and contests across NYC, LA, and the Bay Area, generating 20,000+ activations and 4M+ social impressions.
  • Secured coverage in Bloomberg, the LA Times, and the NY Post.

Doorlist

Content Director

Dec 2025 – Jun 2026

2M+March Madness campaign views

I ran Doorlist's Cal account and filmed its content, while directing the broader March Madness influencer and social campaign.

  • Coordinated content strategy across creators and ambassadors for a campaign surpassing 2M+ views.
  • Managed creator coordination, campaign workflows, and execution using Trello and Notion.
  • Recruited creators and ambassadors to expand distribution and support community-led growth.

swsh

Growth · Fan account strategy

Feb 2026 – Apr 2026

20×fan account view growth
3M+views in four weeks

I invented and led swsh's fan account growth strategy, building content around the artists and moments fans already cared about.

  • Grew fan content for TWICE, John Summit, KATSEYE, Hilary Duff, Zara Larsson, and other artists from 10K to 200K+ views in as little as two weeks.
  • Managed fan and update accounts generating 1M+ combined views in two weeks and 3M+ in four weeks across TikTok and Instagram.
  • Identified organic brand integration opportunities and deployed AI agents for community engagement on X, generating 50K+ impressions.
